public_rationale: The records found do not settle either quantity. NVIDIA's statement concerns utilization of GPUs already installed. It does not establish how many Blackwell GPUs were operating or how many GPUs remained in warehouses. Shipment figures cannot fill that gap, and a die-versus-package distinction cannot establish warehousing.
limitations: Private customer inventories and deployment records were unavailable.
The two parts of the claim require separate evidence.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Millions of GPUs are likely sitting in warehouses; there is no chance that 6 million Blackwell GPUs have been installed and turned on.

statement.excerpt: how there are likely millions of GPUs sitting in warehouses, as there's no chance that 6 million Blackwell GPUs have actually been installed and turned on.

from_speaker: likely millions of GPUs sitting in warehouses
no chance that 6 million Blackwell GPUs have actually been installed and turned on
our_interpretation: Assess the situation as of November 24, 2025, the date explicitly attached to the original analysis.
Read GPUs as data-center accelerators in this context, excluding consumer graphics cards.
Read millions as at least two million. Preserve the uncertainty expressed by likely.
The six-million comparison must use a consistent counting convention for GPU dies and complete accelerator packages.
Fewer than six million operating Blackwell GPUs would not, by itself, establish that millions were in warehouses.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable deployment and inventory records establish fewer than six million installed and powered-on Blackwell GPUs, using consistent units, and substantiate the likelihood that at least two million GPUs were warehoused awaiting installation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish at least six million Blackwell GPUs installed and powered on by the target date, or comprehensive inventory evidence rules out millions of warehoused GPUs. Evidence resolving only one component would leave the other component unsettled.
